items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Our band consists of ... Sidney Flutcher. That was our band at the La Vida.

ctx.x: The street taxi dance hall. Our band consists of Raymond Brown, which is Clifford. We call him Clifford, but his name is Raymond. He lives in Frisco. Bat Brown's nephew. Yeah, yeah. And him, and Handley, Williams Kelly, Lewis Gibbons, and Sidney Flutcher. That was our band at the La Vida. How long did you stay there about? I stayed there. I went there in 27. I stayed there about a year.
